description: A biome is a world of its own: rainforest, dry zone, highland or coast, each changing in its own way. We are Biome, taking on “Be An Earth System Trend Detective!” at NASA Space Apps 2026 in Kandy. We’re building a tool that lets students and the public pick a place and a question, then see what is changing, where, by how much, and whether the trend is statistically significant, using 25 years of NASA rainfall, vegetation, temperature and soil moisture data.
